name: XGR
shortDescription: Native asset of XGRChain and the XETA EVM interchain hub.
description: XGR is the native asset of XGRChain, an EVM-compatible blockchain. XETA (XGR EVM Token Alliance) provides validator-quorum-governed token transfers between XGRChain and supported external EVM networks. Individual transfer routes become available only after independent deployment verification and governance activation.
